name: Qiuhua

skills.name: Trailblaze
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Searing Sizzle
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Burn damage equivalent to 120% ATK to it. If the distance between Qiuhua and the target is less or equal to 4 tiles, increases damage dealt by 5% and Stability damage dealt by 1 point

skills.name: Soaring Leap
skills.description: Selects a tile within a 6 tile radius of self and lands on the selected tile, dealing Burn damage equivalent to 30% ATK to the nearest enemy target within a 6 tile radius. After attacking, gains Extra Command. Reduces the cooldown of Ultimate by 1 turn

skills.name: Boil and Reduce
skills.description: Selects a tile within a 6 tile radius of self, dealing AoE Burn damage equivalent to 90% ATK and applying Scorch Mark to all enemies within a 3 tile radius of the specified tile. This skill consumes all Confectance Index, for each point of Confectance Index consumed, increases damage multiplier by 5%

skills.name: Zao Jun's Rule
skills.description:
When there are no allies within a 2 tile radius of self, increases Burn damage dealt by 5%

If Overburn is applied on an enemy within attack range, Qiuhua launches one instance of Emergency Support to the target, dealing Burn damage equivalent to 60% ATK and 1 Stability Damage, and increases Confectance Index by 1 point. This effect can be activated once per turn

Increases CRIT rate by 30% when dealing Burn damage towards targets with Scorch Mark

fortification.effect: Reduces cooldown by 1 turn. When dealing damage, immediately triggers the effect of Scorch Mark that are triggered at the end of the holder's action once

Emergency Support can be activated 1 → 2 times per turn

Increases Burn damage dealt by 5% → 15%. Removes the condition required to activate this effect

When dealing damage, if CRIT rate is above 100%, each 1% additional CRIT rate is converted into 1% CRIT DMG

Scorch Mark no longer has a maximum stack limit

New effect is added when dealing Burn damage towards targets with Scorch Mark - if the number of stacks of Scorch Mark is more than 10, for each additional stack, increases ATK by 1%

Increases damage multiplier by 50%

If the target has Scorch Mark, deals an additional instance of fixed damage equivalent to 50% ATK

After attacking, gains Phase Boost II and Stability Offensive II for 1 turn

After attacking, gains 6 tiles of Additional Movement

If the target has Scorch Mark, increases damage dealt by 30%

If the distance between Qiuhua and the target is less or equal to 4 tiles, increases damage dealt by 5% → 15% and Stability damage dealt by 1 → 2 points

If this skill hit 1 target, increases damage dealt by 15%

Enhanced the effects of Scorch Mark - increases damage dealt per stack to 10% of the caster's ATK, and increases the number of stack gained when receiving Burn damage to 2

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Meal Prep
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, increases Confectance Index by 3 points

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Roaring Stove
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, applies Scorch Mark to the enemy with the highest HP. This has a cooldown of 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Slice and Dice
keys.effect: Becomes immune to all debuffs inflicted by Burn tiles and all Burn type debuffs. At the end of the action, if Qiuhua is on a Burn tile, restores 2 Stability and HP equivalent to 10% max HP

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Fragrant Stir-Fry
keys.effect: Before using an active attack, applies Overburn on the target for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Cooking Smoke
keys.effect: After moving, gains 1 stack of Quick Barrier

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Bloated Belly
keys.effect: Before undergoing Emergency Support, dispels 1 buff from the target

keys.name: Common Key
keys.effect: CRIT +5.0% / When Out-of-Turn attack deals Burn damage, increases damage dealt by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect:
Emergency Support damage multiplier is increased by 30% and when dealing damage, ignores 15% of target's defense; for each Emergency Support performed, gain 1 stack of Wok Aura for 2 rounds.

Wok Aura: Burn damage dealt increased by 7%, damage taken reduced by 7%, stacks up to 4 times. Considered a Burn buff, cannot be cleansed.

When a unit with Scorch Mark dies, deals AoE Burn damage equal to 130% of Qiuhua's attack to all allied units within a radius of 3 tiles.

When the active skill Soaring Leap deals damage, creates Incineration tiles within a radius of 1 tile around the target, lasting for 2 turns.

source_notes: Extracted from GFL2 Official Release Info Compilation.xlsx with online Dandegate/gfl2.help enrichment.
